sloka: राजानम् प्रश्रितैः वाक्यैः आनयंतु पुरम् मम ।प्रदानम् वीर्य शुक्लायाः कथयंतु च सर्वशः ॥१-६७-२५॥
transliteration: rājānam praśritaiḥ vākyaiḥ ānayaṁtu puram mama ।pradānam vīrya śuklāyāḥ kathayaṁtu ca sarvaśaḥ ॥1-67-25॥

translations.english: That Sita, the reward of prowess is to be given to Rama be reventially communicated in detail to king Dasaratha and he may be conveyed here.
